_comment: Environment contract of src/config.js. Every row starts from valid_env, unsets the variables in unset or applies set. The config module reads the environment once, when it is loaded. expected is the complete exported object; every value is a string.

missing.name: with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (USERNAME before PASSWORD)
with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (MQTT_PORT before MQTT_PASSWORD)
with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (HOSTNAME before USERNAME)
missing.note: Only the order of the report is pinned; a port may name every missing variable at once.

missing.name: with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (PASSWORD before PORT)
missing.note: Only the order of the report is pinned; a port may name every missing variable at once.

missing.name: with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (PORT before MQTT_HOSTNAME)
missing.note: Only the order of the report is pinned; a port may name every missing variable at once.

missing.name: with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (MQTT_HOSTNAME before MQTT_PORT)
missing.note: Only the order of the report is pinned; a port may name every missing variable at once.

missing.name: with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (MQTT_PORT before MQTT_USERNAME)
missing.note: Only the order of the report is pinned; a port may name every missing variable at once.

missing.name: with several missing, the first in declaration order is reported (MQTT_USERNAME before MQTT_PASSWORD)
missing.note: Only the order of the report is pinned; a port may name every missing variable at once.

accepted.name: empty strings are accepted for every variable
accepted.note: Only a missing variable is an error; an empty value is accepted as is. Empty MQTT_USERNAME/MQTT_PASSWORD do not mean "no broker credentials": the broker still receives a username (see mqtt.json, KB-8).

accepted.name: values are kept verbatim: no trimming, no number conversion
